title: [Card Bug] My Precious: Don't need to pay equip cost of 2 life
scope: My Precious 'Equip-{2}, Pay 2 life' (ability_index 0); native engine, P0 human driver seat, P1 = native Easy AI; protocol-98 driver

Precious attached to Memnite; Memnite gained Hexproof from the static ability. The reported 0.52.0 behavior (equip requiring only {2}, no life payment) does not occur on v0.99.0.
